before: Each typed character that landed in its own task was a separate local undo step. Collaborative typing merged by a five-second capture window.
after: A typing run is one undo step locally and in collaboration. A caret move, another edit, undo, redo, a caret format, or another participant's change to the run's paragraph ends the run.
reason: Only each participant's own undo grouping changes. Shared state, operations, journals, and update meaning stay the same, so released participants interoperate unchanged.
